findings.entity: Front numeral of the handled green block at the third position
findings.description: The clearly readable front '2' at 00:02.25–00:02.42 becomes '3' at 00:02.50–00:02.75 while that face remains directed toward the viewer. The hand lifts and slightly tilts the block without turning a different face into view or replacing the printed numeral.

findings.entity: Front numeral of the block being placed fourth
findings.description: The held block reads '3' at 00:03.50–00:03.58, then '2' at 00:03.75 and clearly at 00:04.00. Its front remains visible during the small tilt; no face-changing rotation or rewriting explains the changed digit.

findings.entity: Front numeral of the green block being placed sixth
findings.description: The front reads '3' at 00:05.75–00:05.92 and '5' at 00:06.00. The visible face changes while the block is lowered, with another '3' emerging to the right. There is no visible rotation to a different face or legitimate alteration of the printed character.

findings.entity: Front numeral of the green block being placed seventh
findings.description: The held front face reads '3' at 00:06.50–00:06.67, then the placed face reads '2' at 00:06.75, while another '3' appears to its right. The numeral changes on the viewer-facing surface without a visible face-changing turn or replacement of its text.

findings.entity: Front numeral of the rightmost blue block
findings.description: The same held blue block clearly reads '3' at 00:07.50–00:07.67 and '6' at 00:07.75–00:08.00. Its front stays toward the camera as it is lowered; the slight tilt cannot expose a different cube face, and no action changes the printed text.
